title: QuentinElGuay/portfolio-ai-tour-guide
summary: QuentinElGuay的AI旅游助手项目使用RAG技术，从PDF旅游指南中提取知识来回答游客问题，为法国假期提供个性化服务。该项目是2026年LLM Zoomcamp的毕业设计，采用Python编写，结合了模型训练、推理和向量索引技术，适用于旅游信息查询和个性化推荐场景。
description: AI travel assistant to prepare your holidays in France, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer travelers' questions using knowledge from PDF tourism guides. Built as the capstone project for the 2026 LLM Zoomcamp.
